verses.text: Hallelujah! Praise the name of the LORD. Give praise, O servants of the LORD,

segments.text: Hallelujah! Praise the name of the LORD. Give praise, O servants of the LORD,

verses.text: who stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God.

segments.text: who stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God.

verses.text: Hallelujah, for the LORD is good; sing praises to His name, for it is lovely.

segments.text: Hallelujah, for the LORD is good; sing praises to His name, for it is lovely.

verses.text: For the LORD has chosen Jacob as His own, Israel as His treasured possession.

segments.text: For the LORD has chosen Jacob as His own, Israel as His treasured possession.

verses.text: For I know that the LORD is great; our Lord is above all gods.

segments.text: For I know that the LORD is great; our Lord is above all gods.

verses.text: The LORD does all that pleases Him in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and in all their depths.

segments.text: The LORD does all that pleases Him in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and in all their depths.

verses.text: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.

segments.text: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.

verses.text: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, of both man and beast.

segments.text: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, of both man and beast.

verses.text: He sent signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.

segments.text: He sent signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.

verses.text: He struck down many nations and slaughtered mighty kings:

segments.text: He struck down many nations and slaughtered mighty kings:

verses.text: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kings of Canaan.

segments.text: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kings of Canaan.

verses.text: He gave their land as an inheritance, as a heritage to His people Israel.

segments.text: He gave their land as an inheritance, as a heritage to His people Israel.

verses.text: Your name, O LORD, endures forever, Your renown, O LORD, through all generations.

segments.text: Your name, O LORD, endures forever, Your renown, O LORD, through all generations.

verses.text: For the LORD will vindicate His people and will have compassion on His servants.

segments.text: For the LORD will vindicate His people and will have compassion on His servants.

verses.text: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.

segments.text: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.

verses.text: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;

segments.text: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;

verses.text: they have ears, but cannot hear; nor is there breath in their mouths.

segments.text: they have ears, but cannot hear; nor is there breath in their mouths.

verses.text: Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.

segments.text: Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.

verses.text: O house of Israel, bless the LORD; O house of Aaron, bless the LORD;

segments.text: O house of Israel, bless the LORD; O house of Aaron, bless the LORD;

verses.text: O house of Levi, bless the LORD; you who fear the LORD, bless the LORD!

segments.text: O house of Levi, bless the LORD; you who fear the LORD, bless the LORD!

verses.text: Blessed be the LORD from Zion—He who dwells in Jerusalem. Hallelujah!

segments.text: Blessed be the LORD from Zion—He who dwells in Jerusalem. Hallelujah!
